title: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower

entities.name: Kirol
entities.description: A vampire Strixhaven student held prisoner by Lluwen and brought before Morcant.

entities.name: Lluwen
entities.description: A hooved elf hunter of the Nightshade pack who captures Kirol and takes them to Lys Alana.

entities.name: Morcant
entities.description: The golden-hooved High Perfect of Lys Alana, who plans to kill Isilu and revive the Gilt-Leaf Empire.

entities.name: Lys Alana
entities.description: A gilded city of boardwalks and towers in the Gilt-Leaf forest where Morcant rules.

entities.name: Gilt-Leaf Empire
entities.description: The elvish realm Morcant hopes to see rise again.

entities.name: Isilu
entities.description: The moon-headed incarnation, now awake and out of cycle.

entities.name: Eirdu
entities.description: The sun incarnation, who is still awake and who has left Maralen's court.

entities.name: Abigale
entities.description: An owlin student who falls into a tributary, uses air magic to breathe, and is taken by merrow toward the Wanderwine.

entities.name: Sanar
entities.description: A goblin student who is flung by a beast's antlers and later follows Tam to Maralen.

entities.name: Tamira
entities.description: A gorgon student who uses probability magic and goes behind the waterfall to Glen Elendra.

entities.name: Brigid Baeli
entities.description: A kithkin hero who gave the students directions.

entities.name: Merrow
entities.description: Fish-finned bipeds with spears who find Abigale in the stream and sign to her.

entities.name: Maralen
entities.description: The faerie queen, who finds flower petals of Oona's flesh and fears Oona is returning.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: The former faerie queen who made Maralen and whose return Maralen fears.

entities.name: Rhys
entities.description: Maralen's adviser and oldest friend, who tries to kill her to keep his promise but slips on petals and falls out a window.

entities.name: Blue faerie
entities.description: The small blue faerie, sitting on Rhys's shoulder, that lured the students; it later joins Maralen.

entities.name: Faeries
entities.description: Maralen's palace faeries who escort Tam and Sanar to her.

entities.name: Glen Elendra
entities.description: Maralen's hidden palace behind the waterfall.

entities.name: Gilt-Leaf Wood
entities.description: The forest containing Lys Alana and the waterfall route to Glen Elendra.

entities.name: Wanderwine
entities.description: The large river toward which the tributary carries Abigale.

entities.name: Goldmeadow
entities.description: The village where Isilu walks and which may be lost to Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Great Aurora
entities.description: The old cycle that once dictated the wakings of the incarnations and that is now gone.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The university on Arcavios that the students come from.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The students' home plane.

entities.name: Lorwyn-Shadowmoor
entities.description: The twinned plane the students are stranded on.

events.summary: Lluwen marches Kirol through the forest while they argue about hiking shoes and hooves.
events.quote: That's because you don't have feet,

events.summary: Lluwen brings Kirol to Lys Alana, a gilded city of boardwalks and towers.
events.quote: Come along. I'm taking you to High Perfect Morcant now.

events.summary: Lluwen presents Kirol to Morcant, claiming they know something of why Isilu walks out of sync.
events.quote: I've found a stranger in the forest who knows something of Isilu and why he walks out of sync with his promised time.

events.summary: Kirol recounts how the students woke Isilu; Morcant says Isilu should not have awakened for about six months.
events.quote: Isilu shouldn't have awoken until a good six months from now.

events.summary: Morcant explains her view of Eirdu and Isilu and sees Isilu's vulnerability as a chance to end the night forever and raise the Gilt-Leaf Empire again.
events.quote: If they could end the night forever, and welcome endless day in its place.

events.summary: Morcant muses about killing the night with dawnglow mixed with summer dreams, horrifying Lluwen.
events.quote: With the weapons of the night, of course.

events.summary: Morcant refuses to let Kirol leave, declaring that she needs them.
events.quote: We need you. You're not going anywhere.

events.summary: Sanar, Tam and Abigale realize Kirol is missing; Abigale resolves to find them and storms off alone.
events.quote: I'm going to go find them. You can wait here if you like.

events.summary: A beast with branch antlers emerges and flings Sanar into the trees.
events.quote: the motion causing one of its antlers to catch him in the chest and fling him away into the trees.

events.summary: Abigale stumbles into the tributary and is swept toward the Wanderwine.
events.quote: As she stumbled, her foot hit the top of the sloping bank that led down to the water, and she fell.

events.summary: Abigale conjures bubbles of air to breathe underwater.
events.quote: Her hands moved, and bubbles began to form around them, answering her call.

events.summary: Fish-people armed with spears surround Abigale; their leader signs to her and invites her to come see something.
events.quote: We have something you must see

events.summary: The merrow tow Abigale into the depths of the Wanderwine.
events.quote: they began to swim toward the Wanderwine proper, towing Abigale along with them.

events.summary: Tam and Sanar decide to find the waterfall instead of chasing Abigale, and Tam steps through the water.
events.quote: She stepped forward.

events.summary: Maralen finds petals of Oona's flesh in her chamber and realizes her independence may be unraveling.
events.quote: These were the petals of Oona's flesh, and they couldn't be here, unless—

events.summary: Maralen sees Oona's gaze in the mirror and hears laughter.
events.quote: she met the terrible gaze of Oona and pushed herself away from the mirror so hard

events.summary: Faeries bring Tam and Sanar to Maralen, and Tam says Brigid sent them.
events.quote: I'm a gorgon. My name is Tam—Brigid sent us.

events.summary: Maralen tells the students Oona is returning and she does not know if she can stop her.
events.quote: Oona is returning, and this time, I don't know if I can stop her.

events.summary: Rhys bursts in with the blue faerie and attacks Maralen with a dagger to keep his promise.
events.quote: The elf drew a dagger from his belt and lunged.

events.summary: Rhys slips on flower petals and tumbles out a window.
events.quote: Rhys took two wild, stumbling steps and tumbled out of a nearby window.

events.summary: Maralen explains the death pact and flees with Tam, Sanar and the blue faerie before Rhys returns.
events.quote: But I'm not ready to die, and if we can settle Isilu and restore the cycle, I may not have to.

relations.note: He brings his captive to the High Perfect.
relations.quote: I'm taking you to High Perfect Morcant now.

relations.note: Morcant is High Perfect of Lys Alana.
relations.quote: I am High Perfect here in Lys Alana.

relations.note: She plans to kill the night elemental.
relations.quote: and all the power of the night won't save the beast.

relations.note: Adviser and oldest friend, bound by a death pact.
relations.quote: That was Rhys, my adviser and oldest friend, and he'll kill me if he thinks Oona is coming back.
She had been born of them, once, when she was made by Oona

relations.note: Brigid sent the students to Maralen.

relations.quote: You're supposed to serve me, not betray me,

relations.note: Maralen's chamber is in the palace.
relations.quote: This is Lorwyn-Shadowmoor, and you are very far from your Arcavios.
